datapoints.description: Checks if the version is not the same as the suggested and if its over 6 months to alert.
datapoints.name: Alert

appliesTo:
(
!isClient_GroundEffects()
)

&& 
(
system.sysinfo =~ "Cisco IOS" ||
System.sysinfo =~ "Cisco NX-OS"
)
&&
(
/*HyperFlex*/
system.sysoid != "1.3.6.1.4.1.9.12.3.1.3.1062"
)

&& exists("auto.entphysical.modelname")
&& exists("auto.entphysical.softwarerev")
&& system.sysoid != "1.3.6.1.4.1.9.1.1537"
&& auto.entphysical.modelname != "C8000V"

filters.value: Please enter a valid release version

name: Cisco Software Suggested Release
